entries.definition: Accepts an invitation, creating the identity's membership.
entries.authority: Transitions a valid PENDING Invitation to ACCEPTED, renders its acceptance secret unusable, and requests membership creation through the Organization-owned CreateMembership command boundary; performs no direct Membership write.

entries.definition: Assigns a content pack to a learner.
entries.authority: Creates Assignment records linking content to learners.

entries.definition: Authenticates an identity's credential and establishes a session.
entries.authority: Creates ApplicationSession; reads Identity and Credential.

entries.definition: Changes an identity's credential.
entries.authority: Changes an identity credential; when authorized by an ACTIVE SetupToken or PasswordResetToken, consumes that token in the same transaction; revokes sessions per the session-revocation policy.

entries.definition: Marks a learning session complete.
entries.authority: Transitions LearningSession to completed.

entries.definition: Creates an application session for an authenticated identity.
entries.authority: Creates ApplicationSession.

entries.definition: Creates a new application identity.
entries.authority: Creates Identity and its primary Credential.

entries.definition: Creates a membership linking an identity to an organization.
entries.authority: Creates Membership.

entries.definition: Deactivates an identity for a reason other than offboarding.
entries.authority: Transitions Identity ACTIVE -> INACTIVE; emits IdentityDeactivated.

entries.definition: Deactivates a membership.
entries.authority: Transitions Membership ACTIVE -> INACTIVE.

entries.definition: Invites a prospective identity to join.
entries.authority: Creates a PENDING Invitation with an Invitation-owned hashed acceptance secret and the canonical 7-day expiry; creates no membership.

entries.definition: Issues a certification to an identity.
entries.authority: Creates Certification.

entries.definition: Offboards an identity.
entries.authority: Transitions Identity to INACTIVE; revokes sessions, credentials, and memberships; emits IdentityOffboarded.

entries.definition: Publishes a content pack.
entries.authority: Transitions ContentPack to published state.

entries.definition: Reactivates a deactivated identity.
entries.authority: Transitions Identity INACTIVE -> ACTIVE; emits IdentityReactivated.

entries.definition: Reconciles an ambiguous external effect before retry.
entries.authority: Reads canonical provider state for an OPEN ReconciliationRecord and resolves it only to CONFIRMED_SUCCESS or CONFIRMED_NO_EFFECT; never retries while unresolved.

entries.definition: Records a progress event in a learning session.
entries.authority: Appends ProgressEvent to a LearningSession.

entries.definition: Revokes an application session before expiry.
entries.authority: Transitions ApplicationSession to revoked; emits ApplicationSessionRevoked.

entries.definition: Revokes a certification.
entries.authority: Transitions Certification to revoked; emits CertificationRevoked.

entries.definition: Revokes a pending invitation and renders its acceptance secret unusable.
entries.authority: Transitions Invitation PENDING -> REVOKED and invalidates the Invitation-owned acceptance secret in the same transaction.

entries.definition: Revokes a membership.
entries.authority: Transitions Membership INACTIVE -> REVOKED; emits MembershipRevoked.

entries.definition: Revokes a single-use token before expiry.
entries.authority: Transitions an ACTIVE SetupToken or PasswordResetToken to REVOKED; subsequent use is rejected.

entries.definition: Starts a learning session from an assignment.
entries.authority: Creates LearningSession; emits LearningSessionStarted.
